subject.title: add option for MCP apps support

question: After the pagination defect is fixed and exact-head proof is verified, should OpenClaw core own this default-off stable MCP Apps host and its executable-UI/tool-resource trust boundary?
rationale: A mechanical fix cannot decide permanent core ownership of the new configuration, Gateway API, third-party HTML execution, and app-originated MCP access surface.

options.title: Accept the bounded host
options.body: Approve the lease-based default-off design after the cursor fix, focused tests, and live proof.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Ship app rendering without app-initiated tool or resource calls and revisit the broader bridge separately.

options.title: Decline core hosting
options.body: Retain normal MCP tool support but do not accept the Apps host security surface in core.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded host
recommendation.body: Approve the lease-based default-off design after the cursor fix, focused tests, and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current consolidated implementation and redesign, making him the strongest available owner for the final core and security direction.
